newsitem.title: USA: Interiors Inc agrees to sell division for $650,000.
newsitem.headline: Interiors Inc agrees to sell division for $650,000.

text.p: Interiors Inc said on Friday that it agreed to sell its canvas stretching division and related assets to Photo-To-Art Inc for $650,000 in stock and cash.
The transaction also includes a three-year, 70,000 leasing agreement, Interiors Inc said in a statement.

In addition, the company said it agreed to sell $500,000 of non-productive inventory related to its discontinued catalog operation to an unnamed New York advertising wholesaler, in exchange for print advertising space and television advertising time.
Interiors Inc manufactures antique reproductions and contemporary picture frames.
